Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
 
In accordance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that an Earnings Conference Call in relation to the financial 
results of the Company for the quarter and six months ended on 30 September 2026 is scheduled on 
Thursday, 29 October 2026 at 01:00 p.m. IST with the Senior Management of the Company. 
 
The Earning Conference Call Invite for the above is enclosed. 
 
We request you to take the above on record.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully,
